notes.title: Under Siege Store Page Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello, dear strategists and defenders of Shieldhaven!

We are incredibly excited to announce that the store page for Under Siege is officially live! Today marks a significant milestone in our journey, and we're thrilled to have you be a part of it.

Under Siege has been a labor of love, blending intense roguelike elements with a reverse bullet hell twist, all set in a vivid 3D world teeming with charismatic 2D characters. From the verdant landscapes of our central hub, Shieldhaven, to the impending battles that lie ahead, we promise a gaming experience like no other.

But this is only the beginning. With our Steam page now live, we are gearing up for our Early Access release. We want to create a game that resonates with each one of you, and your feedback will be invaluable in this next phase.

What Can You Do Now?

   - Check out the store page and add Under Siege to your wishlist.
   - Dive into the game's features, screenshots, and other tidbits we've shared.
   - Engage with us on Discord! Share your thoughts, expectations, and feedback. We're here to listen.

The war drums are echoing in the distance, and the siege is about to begin. Prepare your strategies, and let's embark on this epic journey together!

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, stand strong, strategists!

Warm regards,

Glitched Protocol
